title: Hush
concept: A descent from suspended, frozen particles into a state of agitated, glowing chemical decay, concluding in a silent, crystalline suspension.
style: No people, no figures, no buildings, no landscape, no horizon. No object with a visible outline — no vessel, bowl, panel or plate. The matter fills the frame edge to edge and continues past it.
